name: Bor Wishes to Speak
label: Quest
description: Bor Wishes to Speak: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you can disguise yourself as a ruling member of the Twilight Council, I am certain Bor Wildmane will want to speak with you. Go see him, and prepare yourself for a very difficult mission...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, that's right, friend. I have a very tough task ahead...
